summary: Exited at +29.75pts after the trend efficiency ratio (ER10) collapsed from ~0.75 down to 0.09 over six consecutive frames, coinciding with repeated PROPP/HA/KMDR-against fires and price failing to make new highs after an intrabar peak near +55 - a clear signature of trend exhaustion into chop rather than continuation.
